description.en:
New Video Series Plan (ver. 5)
Date: May 12, 1097
Video titles:
'Learn Minerals With Muriel!' (nope, doesn't stand out!)
'Do You REALLY Understand These Minerals?' (nope, of course they don't!)
'How long does it take for an ore to MATURE?' (alt title, 'mature' should sound interesting imo)
'An Ore Collector Stayed in Rim Billiton for Three Months and CHANGED INTO THIS...' (alt title, clickbait feels outdated)
'The Hidden Secrets behind Ore' (I don't wanna think of any more titles! Should I just go with the first one?)
Contents: Introduce some ores placed in a cabinet.
Style: Variety show vibes, different from casual adventure videos.
Purpose: Introduce and explain these ores in an easily understandable manner.
Duration: Try to stay within 10-20 min (don't drag on forever!).
Subsections:
1. Overview (1-3 min)
Briefly introduce the episode's theme
2. Introduce ores (5-8 min)
Talk about each ore's history (plan this around their most attractive quality and SHOW it! don't just read the script!)
3. Tell a story about finding these ores (5-8 min)
Edit clips from past adventure videos and show audience while explaining (fumbled hard here before! Explaining what I'm doing in a video isn't as easy as it seems, need to make it more interesting and impactful!)
Notes:
1. Don't glance around, and act livelier. Audiences can tell when you're just reading from the script.
2. Think of the audience as your friends!
3. Follow the plan to a T! Don't change things up as you please!
4. It's too hard! I'm not suited for this kind of thing at all!
5. Ahhhhhh why am I so bad at this! Why did I get Oripathy!!!
[A blank space accompanied with various doodles. The most eye-catching drawing is of a mineral. Several wet marks can be seen next to it, like tear stains.]
6. Listen, Muriel. I know you've failed a few times. You don't want to try anymore, you just want to crawl into bed and sob yourself sore. But you don't want to give it all up yet, right? So cheer up, start the new show, and continue your life on the intercity net. Isn't that what you decided on?
description.zh:
新系列视频企划案（第五版）
时间：1097年5月12日
系列名：
《跟着穆丽儿学习矿石知识》（不行，不够有特色！）
《你真的以为你了解这些矿石吗？》（不对，观众本来就不了解呀！）
《一块矿石多久才算“成年”？》（备选，感觉“成年”这个说法应该有趣一些？）
《一个矿石收藏家在雷姆必拓待了三个月，她身上发生了这样的变化……》（备选，这个梗感觉有点过时了）
《矿石的秘密》（不想想啦！！要不然还是用回我最早的系列视频的名称吧？）
视频内容：介绍挑选好放在柜子里的这一批矿石
视频风格：要有一些综艺感，和探险视频的随性风格做出区分
视频目的：用通俗易懂的方式讲述这批矿石的有关知识
视频时长：控制在10-20分钟（不要每次都说过头！）
视频分段主题：
1.综述（1-3分钟）
简明扼要地介绍本期节目的主旨
2.介绍矿石（5-8分钟）
讲述每块矿石的历史（围绕最抓人的点去设计，把这点呈现出来！不要只是读台本！）
3.讲找到这些矿石的故事（5-8分钟）
剪辑过去探险视频里的片段，配上解说呈现给观众（之前吃了大亏的地方！不要以为介绍视频里自己在做的事很简单，要说得更有趣更生动一些！）
注意事项：
1.不要乱瞟，活跃一些，观众看得出你是不是在念稿。
2.要把观众想象成你的朋友！
3.严格按照计划执行！不要随意更改计划！
4.太难了！我根本不适合做这种事！
5.啊啊啊为什么我非要做这种事不可！为什么我会得矿石病！！
【这里留了一片空白，空白处有着各种涂鸦，其中最显眼的是一块矿石，矿石旁边有几块污渍，像是泪水滴落留下的痕迹。】
6.听着，穆丽儿，我知道你已经失败了好几次，你不想努力了，你眼下只想钻进被窝里大哭一场。但是，你也不想就这样放弃你的一切，不是吗？那就打起精神，做出新的节目，你不是已经决定了吗？你要在城际网络上，继续你的生活。
